Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to provide cleaning supplies?

No. Our team brings all equipment and eco-friendly products. If you prefer your own, just let us know.

Are your products safe for pets and kids?

Yes. We use non-toxic, plant-based cleaners that are safe for children and pets once dry.

What is your cancellation policy?

Cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 24 hours before your appointment.

Do I need to be home during the clean?

Not at all. Many clients share a door code or leave a key. Every cleaner is background-checked and insured.

What if I am not happy with the result?

Tell us within 24 hours and we will return to re-clean the area at no cost.
